runtime.execution: Asyncio step orchestration with synchronous provider SDK requests; optional local shared Bash or Docker tool routing
runtime.service_boundary: Owns shell/processes, optional Docker, local code index; consumes provider/MCP services.

summary: Tool-driven coding benchmark/CLI harness with configurable native tools, normalized trajectories and optional code index; completion interception and ownership gaps matter.

inspection.scope: Entry interactive loop, BaseAgent/Trae dispatch/results/completion, concrete OpenAI request/history, Bash/editor/JSON/thought/CKG/MCP lifecycles, Docker and recorder/test oracles.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Source only; no SDK/Docker/MCP dependency internals executed. Local Bash state claim contradicted by subshell. Cancellation cleanup and mixed completion batches require discriminating experiments.

actions.name: bash
actions.lifecycle: single owned shell; commands subshell, timeout needs restart; no job IDs

actions.name: str_replace_based_edit_tool
actions.lifecycle: awaited edit; unique replacement; no undo
actions.authority: no approval; absolute path check not workspace containment

actions.name: sequentialthinking

actions.authority: model ends task; not behavioral verification

filesystem.detail: Native text/JSONPath editing plus Bash; absolute paths not contained to workspace.

processes.detail: Local Bash shell has restart/timeout/close but commands subshell; no native job handles and no shared-session concurrency lock.

code_actions.detail: Arbitrary Bash execution plus precise file/JSONPath operations and index search.

persistent_kernel.detail: Shell process persists, but per-command subshell loses shell mutations; no resident language kernel traced.

standing_database.detail: Model-facing ckg is local cached/expiring code index, not shared general standing DB.

workflow_programming.detail: Subclass BaseAgent and supply Tool/config; native thought branches only record metadata, not workflow programs.

multi_model.detail: Selected provider/model config per agent; host can instantiate different agents, no peer coordination.

live_collaboration.detail: No peer agent bus/message protocol in inspected loop/registry.

concurrent_work.detail: Local gather for tool batch; Docker serializes. Shared Bash process has no call serialization.

steering_interrupt.detail: Interactive input only between awaited tasks; synchronous provider blocks event loop. CancelledError can bypass post-finally tool/MCP cleanup.

turn_redefinition.detail: Host subclass hooks fixed step architecture; no model hot turn replacement mechanism.

compaction.detail: No managed compactor in inspected BaseAgent/OpenAI accumulated history.

context_repair.detail: Explicit set_chat_history and trajectory reads give host history replacement; no model repair operation.

original_audit.detail: Trajectory captures normalized completed replies and delta inputs, not full accumulated provider request or raw retries/events. Rewrites can fail silently.

audit_query.detail: JSON trajectory and recorder path host read; no native model audit query.

hot_change.detail: Captured config/tool map and no atomic after-turn/workflow activation in inspected paths.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No outpost transfer or quiescent executable re-inhabitation established.

remote_services.detail: Provider and allowed MCP clients, optional owned Docker deployment.

self_improvement.detail: Agent can edit/code/test through tools, but no controlled harness improvement experiment.

complaints.detail: No model state-capturing complaint artifact traced.

authority.detail: Automatic configured tools local or Docker; allow-listed MCP discovery. No routine command confirmation traced.

evaluation.detail: Source tests exercise shell outputs and nonempty patch acceptance; completion not task correctness, mixed batch untested.

time_order.detail: Step numbers/order and shell deadlines; gather has shared resource races; wall timestamps and mutable JSON not total audit.

evidence.claim: Async task loop calls synchronous provider; docker stop finally but tool/MCP cleanup after finally can be bypassed by cancellation.
Completion checked before dispatch; finalize overrides error state to completed.
Any task_done call denotes completion, must_patch checks non-test patch only, not correctness.
Config parallel option dispatches gather versus sequential then paired results.
Normalized cached name map executes tool with standardized result/error and asyncio.gather.
Owned persistent Bash shell; direct-process terminate/kill+communicate deadlines, not process-group kill.
Each command wrapped in subshell; private buffers polled until sentinel, timeout marks unusable without immediate kill; no invocation lock.
bash schema command/restart, description promises state persistence and raw background shell usage.
Text editor dispatch view/create/str_replace/insert with absolute path and existence checks.
Unique replacement and insert write files; undo explicitly removed.
JSONPath view/set/add/remove with absolute file_path and value/pretty-print.
Thought/revision/branch records held in memory, returns counts and branch IDs; not executable workflow.
Optional ckg tool searches function/class/class_method cached code index.
Old code-index DB files deleted after expiry.
Snapshot-hash SQLite index owned locally; updates reconstruct; no general standing data API.
Allowed MCP server discovery extends model tool list; failures/cancellations cleaned and skipped.
MCP projects first text content only; isError path lacks nonzero error_code.
Docker parallel execution deliberately sequential.
Synchronous provider call uses accumulated message_history, retries, current schemas.
Normalized response and accumulated assistant history; trajectory recorder sees passed delta messages, not full transport history.
Normalized response/content/usage/calls plus passed messages recorded after successful response.
Trajectory rewritten in place; save failures swallowed; serialized tool results omit name.
Simple interactive loop runs tasks then accepts next input; KeyboardInterrupt handling, not live steering.
Actual shell tests check echo/error/restart, no cd/variable persistence or parallel sharing oracle.
Patch filtering and mocked nonempty completion oracle; no task_done mixed batch assertion.
Configuration selects tool classes and local/Docker caller; initial creation clears old CKG.
New task clears task messages but provider history reset not here; tool_names only applied if tool list empty.
Native registry bash, text/json editors, thought, task_done, optional ckg.

tests.focus: Echo, invalid command and explicit shell restart
tests.oracle: Checks concrete output/nonzero error/new echo; does not assert cd/env persistence, deadline cleanup or concurrent call isolation.
Empty test-only patch rejected, mocked nonempty patch accepted; no semantic correctness or combined task_done/tool call oracle.

strengths: Explicit normalized action/result IDs across provider implementations.
JSONPath editor and cached symbol index add expressive targeted actions.
limits: Source only; no SDK/Docker/MCP dependency internals executed. Local Bash state claim contradicted by subshell. Cancellation cleanup and mixed completion batches require discriminating experiments.
arconaut_questions: Should completion acknowledge every co-issued action or forbid mixed completion batches?
Can the harness prove owned processes are stopped after async cancellation, including descendants?
What distinguishes a persistent shell process from persistent shell state and a persistent compute service?
